_purpose: Hardware catalogue of the GPU-demand instances (user 2026-11-05): partitions are ASIL-specific CPU / RAM / storage only (the chip gives the capacities and the price, including its external memory); the GPU is per-cell hardware shared by all partitions of the cell, bought as modules of three types, at most max_units_per_site modules per cell in any mix. Read by tools/arch_v3_prepare.py when the source directory holds a copy (tools/arch_v3_gpu_demand.py puts it there).
